# Corrections Log
Purpose: Track user corrections and convert repeated issues into permanent rules. save those #Entries in rules/Correctionlog.md.
 
## Conversation Start Rule
Read this file before doing anything else in every new conversation.
 
## Entry Format (use exactly)
[date] | what I did | what the correction was | the rule going forward
 
## Entries
[2026-07-27] | created corrections.md | initialized correction tracking process | at the start of every conversation, read corrections.md before any other action
[2026-07-27] | responded with outputs that felt too long | user requested concise fix-task replies | default to maximum 100 words unless user explicitly asks for more
 
## Weekly Review (once per week)
1. Scan all entries from the current and prior weeks.
2. Find any correction pattern that appears 3 or more times.
3. Promote that pattern to a rule in the permanent instructions file.
4. Update matching log entries by appending: became a rule
 
Example:
[2026-07-27] | did X | corrected Y | always do Z | became a rule
